properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The docs site's own shipped JavaScript opens this HTTPS session (footer menu JSON from www.bnbchain.org/api/v1/landing-menus) on default TLS settings. Post-quantum posture is decided by the client runtime: current browsers negotiate X25519MLKEM768 by default; fetch() exposes no group configuration, so this is observable here but not changeable in this code. Fix levers live server-side (enable hybrid groups on the endpoint) and in the runtime, not in this repo.
